info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Result API
Factset Retrieve the completed response for your query.

items.docs:
Returns FactSet content and data in response to the query provided to the `/create` endpoint. This endpoint is the final step in the single-question request process.
Responses contain a combination of Microsoft Adaptive Cards for data/tables and markdown for text.
